message.content: {"summary":"A well-structured, mostly complete mission design for GBR coral monitoring with good STK evidence and justified launch/orbit/ground-segment choices. To reach the top band, resolve internal contradictions in the orbit and EOL reasoning, show the hand calculations behind your inclination plot, explain the RAAN, and fix referencing (no Wikipedia, full bibliography entries).","next_steps":["Correct the contradictory statement that low-resolution images are 'desirable', and rework the EOL section so the drag-sail rationale is logically consistent (e.g. explain the sail as a passive deorbit mechanism deployed once, not implying thrust).","Show the J2 nodal precession equation and hand calculation behind your inclination-altitude plot, state the LTAN/local time of descending node for your SSO, and correct or remove the claim that RAAN 27.33° reflects Kourou's latitude.","Replace Wikipedia and bare URLs with proper references (author, title, date, source), and make in-text citations match the bibliography exactly.","Deepen the Conclusion beyond a recap: add quantitative outcomes (contact statistics, mass/power margins) and a critical evaluation of risks and design trade-offs."],"criteria":{"C1":"Accomplished (8/10). Your Introduction clearly covers the mission (GBR coral monitoring via fluid lensing), rationale, single-spacecraft justification, and users/operator/funding with literature support. To reach the very top, add more depth on customer specifics and operational needs.","C2":"Accomplished (7/10). Strong coverage: Vega E from Kourou justified, orbit elements tabulated, STK screenshots and access reports included, contact frequency quantified, duration and EOL addressed. Next level requires error-free reasoning: fix the resolution contradiction, the circular drag-sail logic, the unexplained RAAN, and include the hand calculation behind the inclination plot.","C3":"Adequate (6/10). Your Conclusion summarises key choices and notes Vega E availability risk, but is largely a recap. Higher marks require deeper critical evaluation and quantitative outcomes drawn from your evidence.","C4":"Adequate (5/10). Clear structure, labelled figures/tables and an executive summary are strengths. To reach Accomplished: use a consistent referencing style (no Wikipedia, no bare URLs), fix stray characters/typos, and make figure captions consistent."}}
